name: Kijishi Sumire
source:
Sumire is extremely serious and often doesn't understand jokes. Her parents are doctors and Sumire is planning to follow in their footsteps. She has recently taken an interest in art, which she enjoys greatly, and holds [url=/c98201]Natsumi[/url] and [url=/c98375]Momo[/url] in high esteem.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
